items.question: What is the toll charged per vehicle when passing a Darb toll gate in Abu Dhabi during peak hours?
items.gold: AED 4 per vehicle during peak hours (7 am to 9 am and 3 pm to 7 pm, Saturday to Thursday).
items.fact: Darb peak-hour toll is AED 4 per vehicle

items.question: What is the approximate length of Al Ittihad Road (E11), the longest road in the UAE?
items.fact: Al Ittihad Road (E11) is about 553 km long
